text:
maya_ae: Quick update from the ACME deal — customer just dropped a new reqs doc and it's a bit of a scope change. They now require: data residency in eu-west-1, attestation for HSM-backed key management, and completion of their security questionnaire before the POC can start.

jason_se: Ugh ok. Do we have an example of the questionnaire? If it's standard SQA we can turn around answers in a day, but HSM + residency affects whether we propose Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.

kate_cust: Hi team — attaching the questionnaire excerpt here (copied):
1) Are encryption keys under customer control (Y/N)?
2) Where is customer data stored?
3) Can audit logs be exported to our SIEM?
We've also added an explicit latency SLO: p99 < 300ms for 8k context.

maya_ae: thanks @kate_cust. For internal folks: customer timeline is tight — wants POC start in 10 business days and finish in 3 weeks. They expect perf benchmark and a small eval set (~200 prompt pairs) demonstrating consistency.

priya_se: 10 business days is tight if we need a Private deployment. For Hosted we can probably carve a Dedicated pool in 5–7 days but HSM/KMS integration usually needs legal/KMS onboarding and network configs. Can we ask them to accept Dedicated with BYOK (bring-your-own-key) via cross-account KMS?

ryan_sec: BYOK via cross-account KMS is acceptable but they asked for HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2 level 3). Our hosted infra currently supports KMS (AES-GCM) and Cloud HSM in select regions only. Need to confirm eu-west-1 HSM availability and runbook for key rotation. I'll start the questionnaire answers.

alex_prod: From product side: two tradeoffs to call out — (a) quantized model variants (int8) save cost but may slightly alter logits; need evals to validate prompt fidelity, (b) caching/prefix-KV will help hit p99 but could cause stale-context edge cases for streaming demos. Suggest we define pass/fail for POC on exact-match/semantic thresholds.

jason_se: Agreed. Proposal: run two parallel tracks — a functional Hosted/Dedicated eval (faster) and a Private/On-prem feasibility assessment (deeper). For the Hosted/Dedicated track we'll:
- provision a dedicated pool in eu-west-1
- enable cross-account KMS stub for BYOK
- run 200-pair eval script (see below)

```
# eval runner (internal)
python tools/eval_runner.py --prompts acme_200.json --model redwood-llama-13b-q4 --metrics semantic_sim,exact_match --repeat 3
```

jason_se: That should give perf + quality within 48h once pool is up.

maya_ae: Pricing question from the customer: will Dedicated pricing change if we enable HSM/BYOK? They flagged that as a potential blocker for purchase approval.

priya_se: Short answer: yes, enabling HSM and customer-managed keys adds infra cost and setup fees. I'll draft a revised quote — two SKUs: Dedicated (no HSM) and Dedicated+BYOK (with HSM setup fee + monthly surcharge).

kate_cust: Can you also confirm whether logs can be exported to our Splunk instance? That's a hard requirement.

ryan_sec: We can export audit logs via secure syslog/export agent to customer SIEM; need network allowlist and a retention SLA. I'll add specifics to the questionnaire.

alex_prod: For the latency SLO, we should lock down sequence length and batching assumptions. If ACME's eval uses 8k context and streaming, that impacts throughput. Requesting their typical prompt/response token distribution is critical.

kate_cust: Example distribution: median prompt 120 tokens, response 450 tokens, 95th percentile response 1,200 tokens. Most calls are single-turn.

jason_se: Thanks — that distribution favors larger KV usage; we'll need to validate memory footprint and choose model variant accordingly. I'll schedule an on-call lab run tomorrow and post logs.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: dedicated-provision-job started by @jason_se at 1778456940 — status: queued.

priya_se: Action items I have: draft dual quote, update POC SOW to include BYOK option, create eval plan + pass/fail thresholds. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ryan_sec: I'll complete initial security questionnaire answers and attach architecture diagram. Expect first draft in 24 hours.

maya_ae: Great. My ask to the group: can we commit to a minimal POC acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow? I want to lock scope before the customer escalates to procurement.

alex_prod: I'll propose acceptance criteria:
- quality: semantic_sim >= 0.82 on ACME eval set OR exact_match >= 0.6 for critical prompts
- perf: p99 < 300ms on 8k context for single-turn with batch size 1
- security: BYOK option documented and questionnaire answered
- logs: SIEM export validated in staging

kate_cust: That sounds reasonable — will validate with our engineering lead and revert. :thumbsup:

maya_ae: Thanks team — I'll sync with ACME and push for the 10-business-day start window. Please call out any blockers ASAP.

jason_se: Noted — blockers right now: HSM availability in eu-west-1, network allowlist window, and Dedicated provisioning queue. I'll follow up in this thread with the lab run logs.

priya_se: +1. If timeline slips > 5 business days we'll propose a reduced-scope hosted demo to keep momentum.

kate_cust: If it helps, we can relax HSM attestation to KMS BYOK for the initial POC only and require full HSM for production. Open to that if it speeds things up.

ryan_sec: That's workable as a temporary mitigation. We'll flag residual risk in the SOW.

maya_ae: Perfect — I'll capture that as an option in the SOW. Closing next steps: Priya quote, Jason lab logs, Ryan security draft, Alex acceptance criteria doc. Back here with updates.
